Saint-Aubin clinic: 4,200 patients, 6 rooms, 12 nurses, 4 admin. Weekdays 08:00–19:00, Saturday 09:00–13:00. Average 180 daily consultations (peak 310, January 2025 flu wave); no-shows 9%, down from 14% after September 2024 reminder texts.

Accreditation runs to April 2027; renewal needs an infection-control audit.

Key incidents: March 2024 vaccine fridge failure (€2,100 lost) led to a networked alarm plus paper backup log; November 2024 concurrent record edit overwrote an allergy field, so records now lock while open.

Rules: no prescription renewal without a consultation in 12 months; vaccine stock counted twice weekly; temperature excursions above 8°C reported same day.

Second ultrasound postponed pending an unused-machine utilisation study. Nursing coordinator vacant since August 2025; two senior nurses covering, unsustainable past winter.
